# Store access token
access_token = login_response['access_token']

# Get liked songs (all pages)
liked_songs = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    liked_songs.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

print(f"Liked songs count: {len(liked_songs)}")
